mainEntity.name: Can I place a tiny home in my backyard as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many of our service areas, including Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, San Marcos, and Escondido, placing a tiny home in your backyard as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a common and often encouraged option. State and local regulations have made it easier to build ADUs. However, there are still specific requirements regarding setbacks from property lines, maximum size limitations, height restrictions, and parking provisions. It's crucial to verify these specific rules for your property's zone and city to ensure compliance before starting any project. We can help assess your property's potential for an ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many areas permit tiny homes as Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) in backyards. You must adhere to specific local rules regarding setbacks, size, height, and parking.
